nodes.title: SG-5.4 Asset preload and validation with fallback used by the scene
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene (game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts) has no preload(); scene object and dust asset ids in bedroom.yaml are never validated against the manifest at load time. Desired behavior: a pure engine planner decides which manifest assets the scene needs and reports unknown or missing ones, and BootScene preloads them and substitutes a fallback texture for any that are missing. Why: missing assets must not crash the scene.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a scene whose objects and effects reference manifest ids, When the preload plan is built, Then it lists each referenced asset once with its path, type and frame spec
- Given a scene referencing an id absent from the manifest or a file that fails to load, When the scene runs, Then the fallback texture key is used and no exception is thrown
- Given BootScene starts, When Phaser calls preload, Then the planned assets are queued through the planner


## Scope
- In scope: engine preload planner
- In scope: fallback texture resolver
- In scope: BootScene preload wiring
- Out of scope: new artwork
- Out of scope: backend changes
- Out of scope: rewriting buildScene
- Preserve: existing manifest schema
- Preserve: existing buildEffects and playSceneTransition behavior


## Technical constraints
- Phaser 3.90 APIs only
- Engine modules under game/src stay Phaser-free and take injected contexts


## Definition of done
- Both requirements are implemented, verified and the scene uses the preload step


## Non-functional requirements
- Unit tests run with Phaser mocked


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Pure preload planner and fallback resolver validate scene asset refs
nodes.body:
A Phaser-free module game/src/engine/preload.ts builds a deduplicated load list from scene object assets and dust effect assets using the manifest, reports unknown ids via the existing checkAssetRefs, and resolves any key to the fallback id when it is unknown or failed to load.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given objects sharing one asset id, When planPreload runs, Then that asset appears once in the entries
- Given a ref not in the manifest, When planPreload runs, Then issues contains one entry naming the ref and entries omit it
- Given a key not in the loaded set, When resolveTextureKey runs, Then it returns FALLBACK_ASSET_ID


## Scope
- In scope: game/src/engine/preload.ts
- Out of scope: Phaser calls
- Preserve: checkAssetRefs and FALLBACK_ASSET_ID in manifestLoader.ts


## Technical constraints
- Reuse checkAssetRefs and FALLBACK_ASSET_ID from manifestLoader.ts, do not duplicate them


## Definition of done
- planPreload and resolveTextureKey exported and typed


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · BootScene preloads planned assets and falls back for missing ones
nodes.body:
BootScene gains preload() that queues each planned entry (image or spritesheet) with this.load, listens for loaderror to record failed keys, and registers a generated fallback texture so missing assets render a visible marker instead of Phaser's default green box or a crash. The manifest is bundled in runtime/content.ts.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a plan with an image and a spritesheet entry, When preload runs, Then this.load.image and this.load.spritesheet are called with the entry key and url
- Given a loaderror event for a key, When it fires, Then that key is recorded as failed and the fallback texture exists
- Given an unknown ref, When the scene resolves a key, Then the fallback key is returned


## Scope
- In scope: BootScene.preload
- In scope: runtime manifest export
- Out of scope: buildScene rendering of objects
- Preserve: BootScene.create effects and transition wiring


## Technical constraints
- Phaser 3.90 loader API


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- BootScene uses planPreload and resolveTextureKey


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.description: Implement the pure planner and the fallback resolver on top of existing manifest types and checkAssetRefs.
acceptance_criteria: planPreload returns deduplicated entries and issues
resolveTextureKey returns the fallback id for unknown or failed keys

steps.action: Create planPreload(manifest: AssetManifest, scene: SceneDef): PreloadPlan. Collect refs from scene.objects[].asset and from scene.effects entries of type 'dust' (their asset). Call checkAssetRefs(manifest, refs) for issues, drop unknown ids, dedupe by id, and map each asset to an entry {id, path, type, frames}.
steps.code:
export type PreloadEntry = { id: string; path: string; type: 'image'|'spritesheet'|'audio'; frames?: AssetEntry['frames'] };
export type PreloadPlan = { entries: PreloadEntry[]; issues: ManifestIssue[] };
steps.expected: Plan for the bedroom scene has unique ids and empty issues

steps.action: Create resolveTextureKey(key: string, loaded: ReadonlySet<string>): string returning key when loaded.has(key), otherwise FALLBACK_ASSET_ID imported from '../assets/loaders/manifestLoader'.
steps.code: export const resolveTextureKey = (key: string, loaded: ReadonlySet<string>) => (loaded.has(key) ? key : FALLBACK_ASSET_ID);

nodes.summary: Add BootScene.preload and bundled manifest export
nodes.description: Export the parsed manifest from runtime/content.ts and add preload() to BootScene using planPreload and a generated fallback texture on loaderror.

steps.action: Add an eager import.meta.glob with query '?raw' of '../../../public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json', JSON.parse the single result, run parseManifest from '@game/assets/manifest'; export const manifest as the data when ok, otherwise {version:1, assets:[]}.
steps.expected: manifest is exported and typed AssetManifest

steps.action: Add preload(): compute plan = planPreload(manifest, scene); for each entry call this.load.image(id, '/assets/' + path) or this.load.spritesheet(id, url, {frameWidth, frameHeight}) from entry.frames; on this.load.on('loaderror', f => this.failed.add(f.key)); add private failed = new Set<string>() and in create() generate the fallback texture with this.textures.generateTexture or graphics under FALLBACK_ASSET_ID when absent.
steps.expected: Entries queued; failed keys recorded; fallback texture present
